  PROBLEM: test_intake_suspect_commits_reuses_the_reproduction_last_green was not updated after suspect_commits (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7031-7053; line 7039 `sha_args = ["-f", f"sha={branch_name}"] if branch_name else []`) changed to send the first-slow-day commits call without `sha` when the default branch is empty, so the test still asserts `slow_day_commits=0 calls=1 last_green=cached` (line 11461) and `not calls["commits"]` (line 11463).
  WHY: The fixture uses `_p2_state()` plus `_p3_state()["trend_runs_pages"]` (regression=true) and never sets `state["slow_day_commits"]`, so the fake gh returns HTTP 404 and the intake logs "outcome=partial reason=slow_day_commits_failed commits=4 files=3 slow_day_commits=0 calls=2 last_green=cached"; CI tests-heal-plan-and-validation shard 1 fails at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:11461 ("1 failed, 177 passed"). The fix belongs in the test: set `state["slow_day_commits"] = _p3_slow_day_commits()`, expect `slow_day_commits=2 calls=2 last_green=cached`, and assert `len(calls["commits"]) == 1` with no `sha=`. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER from sonnet and minimax, MAJOR from luna and glm, none stated by gemini; the highest (BLOCKER) is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6895 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In render_suspect_commits_section, `shown = f", newest {len(commits)} shown" if total > len(commits) else ""` renders "newest N shown" when `_suspect_commit_entry` drops a malformed compare entry (total=4, commits_returned=4, commits_page_truncated=False, kept=3), even though GitHub listed every commit.
  WHY: The heal issue caption misreports listed-vs-shown commits, so an operator thinks a newer commit was left out. The dropped-entry test (tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:11285-11288) only asserts `"GitHub listed only" not in ...`, so this passes silently. Suggested fix: gate the caption on `len(raw_commits) > len(commits)` or `commits_page_truncated`. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6928-6932 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The "newest N shown" caption logic in render_suspect_commits_section is wrong when `_suspect_commit_entry` filters out malformed commits, because `total` comes from GitHub while `commits` is the post-filter count.
  WHY: `len(commits) < total` is true even when GitHub returned every commit, so the caption wrongly says the newest commits are not listed. The source stated no severity; low is the lowest band and is used only to fill the field. This finding is kept separate from the 6895 entry because its line range does not overlap or abut that one.

  PROBLEM: The last autofix run changed the empty-default-branch path. It used to skip the call with partial/default_branch_unavailable; now it sends the first-slow-day commits call without `sha`. The test still asserts "slow_day_commits=0 calls=1 last_green=cached" (line 11461) and `not calls["commits"]` (line 11463). The fixture copies `_p3_state()["trend_runs_pages"]` (regression=true) and never sets `state["slow_day_commits"]`, so the fake gh commits handler (near line 1715) returns `fail("HTTP 404")`.
  WHY: CI check tests-heal-plan-and-validation shard 1 fails at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:11461 with "WORKFLOW_HEAL suspect_commits outcome=partial reason=slow_day_commits_failed commits=4 files=3 slow_day_commits=0 calls=2 last_green=cached" ("1 failed, 177 passed"). Line 11463 would fail next. The helper behaviour is what the issue asks for and stays within budget (2 of at most 3 calls). Fix in the test: set `state["slow_day_commits"] = _p3_slow_day_commits()`, expect "outcome=ok reason=ok commits=4 files=3 slow_day_commits=2 calls=2 last_green=cached", and assert `len(calls["commits"]) == 1` with no "sha=" part. The pre-push gate's "inherited" label is wrong because this test does not exist on the merge-base.
- Cross-pollination notes (no additional findings): this reviewer rejects gemini's `SUMMARIES_FILE`/run-info explanation because the CI log shows commits=4 files=3 last_green=cached. It does not raise glm's caption NIT because the last run did not cause it (total was already 4 before that run). It does not raise the gate failures in tests/test_review_autofix_provider_outage_contract.py and tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py because CI reports only the one failure.
